name: Wichy Painting LLC

reviews.author: Naisleth Rodriguez
reviews.text: He is fantastic and very reliable. Extremely happy with the end results

reviews.author: Alejandro Romo
reviews.text: Very efficient, professional, and friendly service from Wichy. We are very grateful for how our home turned out and would recommend his service to anyone in living in Miami.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Battaglia
reviews.text: Luis did a great job.  He was on time, worked hard and took care with our project.
